facts.company_comparison: Reported KRW 69 billion contract is approximately 2.4 times last year's KRW 29 billion standalone revenue, not 2.4 times consolidated group revenue or earnings.
facts.product_role: Ultracapacitors charge and discharge rapidly to buffer load fluctuations and stabilize fuel-cell system output for AI data centers; stated role is the company's description, not an independently measured performance benchmark.
facts.customer_identity: Primary release identifies a U.S. fuel-cell company without naming it. Media reports name Bloom Energy; that mapping is not established by the retrieved primary release.
facts.increment: A repeat purchase following the initial contract shifts the evidence from a new-market aspiration to a quantified AI-power component order and delivery plan.
facts.conditional_pipeline: The company hopes cumulative orders exceed USD 100 million if additional contracts are signed by year-end; this is conditional discussion, not current firm backlog.
facts.interpretation: If qualified production, utilization and repeat orders sustain margin, this can change the business's earnings duration and mix. Order size relative to standalone revenue does not establish an equivalent consolidated growth rate or net profit.

profit_quality.cfo_mistral_revaluation_description: Approximately 500 million from the first investment tranche.
profit_quality.limitations: Equity gain is below operating income and does not explain gross-margin improvement. A pretax gain cannot be mechanically subtracted from net income to derive after-tax recurring EPS. CFO rounding is not an exact reconciliation of every euro of equity gain.

facts.interpretation: Completed pricing conversations and explicit 2027/2028 timing strengthen evidence of a future pricing mechanism, separately from current volume, mix and installed-base upgrades. Investment revaluation is not recurring equipment operating income or operating cash receipt; operating income nevertheless increased materially.
facts.alternative_and_invalidation: Management-reported timing and unquantified terms do not establish the magnitude of future margin improvement. Shipment mix, delivery delays, order cancellations, export restrictions or cost increases may offset pricing benefits; investment gains can reverse.

coverage.note: Counts use distinct active-universe companies with an identified primary-source fact, not the number of source checks. Accton's partner relationship and monthly revenue count as one company; an earlier count of five had double-counted Accton. Hon Hai and Quanta were added from the regulator event, and Nanya Technology was added from its Q3 2026 company results. Primary-source validation remains partial; no full-universe or valuation conclusion is claimed. Vertiv is not in the current 98-company alpha-quant universe; this run added it as an out-of-universe supplier candidate because a completed 30 MW hyperscale liquid-cooling deployment provides explicit demand-transmission evidence. LG Electronics is not in the current 98-company alpha-quant universe; it was added as an out-of-universe supplier candidate because the signed AIR long-term agreement covers AI data-center projects exceeding 5 GW, while contract value and delivery economics remain undisclosed. Enerflex is not in the current 98-company alpha-quant universe; it was added as an out-of-universe supplier candidate because a contracted over-1-GW behind-the-meter data-center power project lifts the company's related backlog above 1.75 GW, while customer identity, contract value, margin and revenue timing remain undisclosed. Wistron was added from its official October 12 board announcement; 8 distinct active-universe names now have an identified primary-source fact. Historical blocker counts are preserved as dated records. Applied Materials was added as an out-of-universe research candidate from its official AI-related WFE, services and long-term profitability targets; no named incremental CSP order is inferred and primary coverage counts remain unchanged. ASML added as an out-of-universe supplier research candidate from issuer-reported earnings, revised guidance and planned-capacity constraints; no named TSMC or MediaTek order or program delay inferred. Active-universe primary-validation counts unchanged. LS ELECTRIC and LS Materials are out-of-universe candidates with explicit AI data-center power contract evidence; neither changes active-universe primary company counts.
